title: Counterexamples to the continuous Aldous-Lyons conjecture
summary: We construct non-co-sofic invariant random subgroups in connected simple real Lie groups of rank one with finite center, in Zariski connected simple rank-one groups over non-Archimedean local fields, and in Aut(T) for regular and bi-regular trees T. This gives a negative answer to the continuous analogue of the classical Aldous-Lyons conjecture for these groups. Our constructions build on the existence of a finitely generated non-sofic group and answer a question raised in the author's ICM paper [Gel18].
